name: Cantinarr
tagline: Media requests and server management in one app
description: Cantinarr brings media requests and server management into one app. Household members browse and request movies, shows, books, and music, follow downloads, and get notified when content is ready. Admins manage Radarr, Sonarr, Chaptarr, Lidarr, and download clients, review approvals, and investigate stuck downloads from a phone or browser. Connect the services you use after setup. AI is optional: an assistant can help with library questions and requests, while the repair agent investigates persistent download problems and proposes actions for an administrator to review. Cantinarr also offers MCP tools for authorized clients. Service credentials stay server-side and are encrypted at rest.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: ghcr.io/windoze95/cantinarr:1.0.0@sha256:4d061d80aa66f691b2071b43dafd93b604607effa3138862078a341f973e55d4
    container_name: big-bear-cantinarr
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:8585"
    environment:
      CANTINARR_PUSH_GATEWAY_URL: https://push.cantinarr.com
      CANTINARR_ARR_CALLBACK_URL: ""
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config:/config
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "--no-verbose", "--tries=1", "--spider", "http://127.0.0.1:8585/api/health"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 15s
    networks:
      - big_bear_cantinarr_network
networks:
  big_bear_cantinarr_network:
    driver: bridge
notes: Cantinarr runs as a single container and serves its web app and API on port 8585. Keep direct HTTP access on your trusted network and use an HTTPS reverse proxy for remote access. Radarr, Sonarr, Chaptarr, Lidarr, download clients, Tautulli, and Plex are all optional and are added from the admin UI after first run. Push notifications to the companion iPhone and Android apps work out of the box through the preset push gateway; clear CANTINARR_PUSH_GATEWAY_URL to turn them off. If your arr containers cannot reach the address you browse Cantinarr on, set CANTINARR_ARR_CALLBACK_URL to an origin they can dial so instant updates work.
